name: @openflow/bridge
author: Ryan Gavin
description: SessionBridge: the Max for Live device that holds a Live set and serves it to every open[flow] client over WebSocket.

scripts.build: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:device
scripts.qa: export OPENFLOW_QA=1 && npm run build && npm run install:device
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bridge,types,lom -c cyan,blue,magenta "node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tools/dev-bridge.ts" "tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.v8.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.v8.json --noEmit && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json && (test ! -f probe/tsconfig.json || tsc -p probe/tsconfig.json)
